# Pesher Psalms Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 1 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1:1** [...] "Be still before the LORD and wait-patiently for Him; do not fret-yourself over the one who prospers in his way, over the man who carries out evil devices" (Psalm 37:7).

**1:2** [...] and those who turn back from [...]

**1:3** Its pesher concerns the Man of the Lie, who led-astray many with words of falsehood, for they chose worthless-things and did not listen

**1:4** to the Interpreter of Knowledge, who [...]

**1:5** [...] they will perish by sword and by famine and by plague.

**1:6** "For yet a little while and the wicked-one shall be no more; and you shall look-carefully at his place and he shall not be there" (Psalm 37:10).

**1:7** Its pesher concerns all the wickedness at the end of the forty years, for

**1:8** they shall be consumed, and upon the earth there shall not be found any wicked man.

**1:9** "But the meek shall inherit the land and shall delight-themselves in abundance of peace" (Psalm 37:11).

**1:10** Its pesher concerns the congregation of the poor-ones who accept the appointed-time of affliction, and they shall be delivered

**1:11** from all the snares of Belial. And afterward, they shall delight in all the [...] of

**1:12** the earth, and they shall grow-fat on every delicacy of [the] flesh.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from 4Q171 Col. 1. Preserves Hebrew construct chains and sectarian terminology. "Interpreter of Knowledge" (doresh ha-da'at) kept as literal compound. "Man of the Lie" (ish ha-kazav) — standard Qumran designation for a sectarian opponent. "Congregation of the poor-ones" (adat ha-evyonim) preserved as literal construct. Lacunae marked with [...] reflect genuine manuscript damage. The "forty years" reference echoes the Wilderness generation typology.*
